name: Nishiki (Yamaguchi, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nishiki town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised tree of stacked triangles.
history: Flag of the former town of Nishiki in Yamaguchi Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-20.

features.role: Nishiki town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised tree of stacked triangles
